text:
mia: Heads-up: scheduling SDK v5.1.0 + docs_minicook release tomorrow 08:00 PT. Main change: rename `response_format` -> `output_format` across SDK and examples; also tighten snippet validation to require exact JSON keys in examples. Migration plan below.

arthur: Why the rename? Breaking for customers?

mia: Two reasons: (1) consistency with our CLI and Console, which use `output_format`; (2) `response_format` was overloaded with legacy meanings. Behaviour unchanged, purely a key rename. We'll provide a shim in SDKs for 60 days that accepts old key and emits one warning per process.

lexi: Docs impact? Our examples embed config YAML and JSON in many places.

mia: Docs PR includes an automated fixer that updates examples and adds a short note in migration guide. We added a linter rule EXAMPLE_KEY_STRICT (docs-460) that will WARN for 14 days then ERROR. The fixer is conservative: it only rewrites top-level keys in fenced code blocks labeled json/yaml.

qa-bot: CI note: snippet-validator will now enforce exact key sets for example responses. Tests may fail if examples have extraneous keys.

mia: Good call  we'll add a small FAQ section explaining why extra keys get stripped in examples and how to opt-out locally during authoring (`rwi-cli docs-lax-examples --on`).

legal: Quick note: ensure migration guide uses exact consent phrasing when showing sample telemetry opt-in; not directly related but we saw similar wording issues last roll.

mia: Will do. Also: Hosted API will accept both keys for 30 days; after that public endpoints require `output_format`. For Dedicated/Private we'll support both for 6 months but recommend moving to the new key.

arthur: Any CLI helpers? Bulk replace across repos?

mia: Yes: `rwi-cli migrate-key --old response_format --new output_format --check|--fix|--dry-run`. Shipping in `rwi-cli@1.0.3`. The docs PR links to the CLI usage and a sample grep for edge cases.

release-bot: Draft changelog: "SDK v5.1.0: response_format -> output_format (60d shim in SDK, 30d hosted dual-accept, 6mo Dedicated/Private support); strict snippet validation (docs-460); rwi-cli migration helper." Internal checklist: https://internal.redwood/releases/checklists/sdk-5-1-output-format

lexi: I'll run the fixer on the cookbook tonight and open follow-ups if anything odd pops up.

mia: Thanks  please review the PR and migration guide before EOD. I'll email #all at 07:30 PT tomorrow with timeline and links.
